dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: Human? It's been a long time since there has been a human here.

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: But it appears as if you are not someone bound to the Pari. I cannot rely on you.

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: Outlander offerer, have you come bearing Plumes of Purifying Light for the Amrita Pool?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Plume of Purifying Light...

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: Plumes of Purifying Light are fragments of memory. Memories belonging to the divine bird, Pari, and humans. All those memories unable to return to the tree and the land will eventually become Plumes of Purifying Light.

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: Although, should you offer them to the Amrita Pool, all memories will be accepted.

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: You'll have to find those memories scattered across the land that have yet to become Plumes of Purifying Light.

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: The primordial waters of the Amrita are also what imbued us Pari with life.

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: Regardless of regret or woe, the Amrita can wash it away.

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: As long as you have an offering for the Amrita Pool, the waters and the tree will bestow upon you blessings.

dialogues.speaker: Fedhri
dialogues.text: This is also the mercy of the divine.
